object_scope_note: The measured object is OCP's OWN accounting line 'Sulfur' within Note 4.2.2 'Purchases consumed'. It is the general 'sulfur' concept as named by the issuer. This is an ISSUER ACCOUNTING FACT (OCP's own books), never an import value, physical tonnage, Morocco/national demand, or market size.
distinct_lines_not_merged: In the same Note 4.2.2 table, 'Sulfuric acid' is a SEPARATE raw-material line (FY2024 printed '(2,364)'); it is NOT sulfur and is deliberately NOT included in this record's measures. 'Ammonia' (FY2024 '(8,609)') and 'KCL' are likewise distinct lines.
claim_scope: OCP Group's FY2024 consolidated financial statements (Note 4.2.2, 'Analysis of purchases consumed and external charges', 'Purchases consumed', 'In millions of dirhams', page 21) present 'Sulfur' under Purchases of raw materials with a source amount of (8,344) for FY2024 and (8,088) for FY2023. Establishes OCP's OWN disclosed accounting line ONLY. Does NOT establish sulfur import value, physical sulfur tonnage, Morocco/national sulfur demand, or sulfur market size.
